# Direction

DIR-01 — Review whether the process meets its purpose.
Horizon: 2024-12-31
Review role: Program Council

DIR-02 — Publish eligibility rules before each grant cycle.
Horizon: 2027-12-31
Review role: Program Council

DIR-03 — Preserve an auditable selection record for each cycle.
Horizon: 2027-12-31
Review role: Program Council
# Repository Governance Rules

## GOV-01 — Publish criteria

- Rule ID: GOV-01
- Serves: DIR-02
- Rule: Publish the eligibility criteria before accepting applications.
